findings.title: Demo Global Equity Fund is 46.5% of the portfolio
findings.explanation: A large share in one investment means its ups and downs move the whole portfolio.

findings.title: 16.3% of the portfolio is in AED
findings.explanation: Investments in other currencies change in value when exchange rates move, in addition to their own price moves.

findings.title: Cash is 7.8% of the portfolio
findings.explanation: Cash can be used quickly. A small share means most of the portfolio would need to be sold to raise money.

scenarios.title: What if the largest holding were 20% of the portfolio?
scenarios.description: Shows how the concentration reading would change if the largest holding made up 20% of the total.
assumptions: The rest of the portfolio is scaled evenly to make up the difference
No transaction costs, taxes or price changes
scenarios.effect: The largest holding would be 20.0% of the portfolio instead of 46.5%.

scenarios.title: What if AED weakened 10% against the dollar?
scenarios.description: Shows the effect on today's value of a 10% fall in those currencies.
assumptions: Prices in the local currency stay the same
scenarios.effect: The portfolio would be worth about $1,475 less (1.6% of its value).
